info.title: API.SH: Ryanair
info.description: The Ryanair API from API.SH: public Ryanair data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status

parameters.name: key

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
One Ryanair airport: name, city, country, region, coordinates, time zone, base flag, currency, Schengen flag, and every destination served from it (seasonal, new, connecting).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ryanair-airport

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
All airports in the Ryanair network with code, name, city, country, currency, Schengen flag, region, coordinates, time zone and base flag. Filter by text or country.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ryanair-airports

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text in the code, name or city.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Ryanair cheapest fares from an airport
get.description:
The cheapest Ryanair fare to every destination served from an airport (or to one destination) in a date range, cheapest first: destination, price, flight number, departure and arrival times, previous price. Give `return_from` (and optionally `return_to`, `nights_min`, `nights_max`) for return trips with both legs and the total. Filters: destination country, maximum price, weekdays and departure time window.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ryanair-cheapest

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Latest outbound date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default 30 days after date_from.

parameters.name: return_from
parameters.description: Earliest return date (YYYY-MM-DD): makes it a return-trip search.

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: Latest return date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default 30 days after return_from.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Only destinations in this country (2-letter code, e.g. ES).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Only fares up to this price (total for return trips).

parameters.name: return_time_from
parameters.description: Return trips: earliest return departure time (HH:MM).

parameters.name: return_time_to
parameters.description: Return trips: latest return departure time (HH:MM).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The lowest one-way Ryanair fare of each day on one route between `date_from` and `date_to` (up to 92 days a call): departure and arrival time of that flight, price and currency, sold out or no flight that day, and the cheapest day of the range.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ryanair-fares

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD). Default 30 days after date_from.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every destination Ryanair group airlines fly to from an airport: code, name, city, country, region, coordinates, time zone, operating airline, seasonal and new-route flags and connecting airport where the route is not direct.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ryanair-routes

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every scheduled Ryanair flight on a route in a month: date, weekday, flight number, departure and arrival time.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ryanair-schedule

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
